paragraphs: The Viano 2.2 CDI uses the OM646 - a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel. It was fitted from 2003 to 2014 across the W639 generation. The OM646 is a well-known Mercedes diesel engine used across a range of commercial and passenger models of that era, and its timing chain and injector seal wear pattern is well-documented by specialist workshops.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every VIANO 2.2 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the VIANO 2.2 CDI from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the Viano range spans both diesel and petrol engines across the W639 generation, fitting the wrong replacement - or assuming a component from a petrol Viano will work on your 2.2 CDI - risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Viano quote - it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
